About these recipes · Draft collection

55 recipes, including 29 Filipino dishes. Original drafts and credited open-license adaptations; not yet kitchen-tested. Easy means straightforward techniques, Intermediate needs more coordination, and Chef level involves several stages or careful heat control. These are app estimates, not chef certification. Food preferences use required ingredients; check product labels for allergens.
